Subject: Offer economics for L4 SDE candidate Evan Cho — request approval

Hi Mina / Laura,

Quick context: Evan Cho (L4 SDE, ex-ScaleStart) is at final stage — recruiter signaled he wants an offer by EOD to match a competing bid. Attached is the comp calc and a draft offer template. Headcount is from FY28 IC Eng bucket (cost center 4301).

Proposed package (base case, within band):
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 10% (discretionary, annual)
- RSU grant: $40,000 (4-yr cliff/annual)
- Sign-on: none indicated

Notes: Evan has strong backend systems experience and SLO-driven infra familiarity; hiring manager is pushing for a slightly richer base to win. The current L4 band midpoint is $158k base, RSU median $35k; this mix leans a little toward base.

Attachments: EvanCho_OfferCalc.xlsx (breakdown by comp band scenarios), redwood-offer-template.pdf (standard T&Cs).

Can you please review and let me know if we have sign-off to issue the offer as-is, or whether we need people ops/legal to do an exception? If we need to adjust, the manager has endorsed moving to a $170k base to close.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Technical Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Offer economics for L4 SDE candidate Evan Cho — request approval

Thanks for the packet, Karthik — skimmed the calc. A couple of data points / concerns:

- Base of $165k is slightly above midpoint but still within band tolerance; the bigger ask is $170k which would push above our normal threshold for L4 (we usually stay <= +6% of midpoint without comp authority).
- RSU at $40k is fine, but I'm more comfortable if equity isn't reduced when we increase base. If we must shift, prefer moderating RSU to $35k and keep base at $170k only if we get comp authority sign-off.
- Is there a sign-on or relocation expected? The packet shows none but recruiter hinted at relocation stipend. That matters for total cash.

If Mina is OK with a one-off base exception to $170k given competing offer strength, I can approve. Otherwise, request manager prioritize base or sign-on clarity and share competing offer timeline.

Laura Bennett
VP People & Talent
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick review, Laura. Couple clarifications from the hiring manager / recruiter:

- Competing offer: verbal at $170k base + 15% bonus + $30k RSU equivalent. Candidate is requesting parity on base.
- Relocation: manager confirmed no relocation stipend required — candidate is remote but will be in-office 2 days/week.
- Sign-on: manager is open to a small pro-rated sign-on (up to $5k) if needed, but prefer to prioritize base.

Proposed compromise to move quickly:
- Base: $170,000 (exception request)
- Bonus: 10% target (unchanged)
- RSU: $35,000 grant (keeps equity near band median)
- Sign-on: up to $5,000 discretionary

If Mina signs off on a one-time exception to base, we will proceed to People Ops to issue the formal offer and route to legal for the DocuSign. Manager is prepared to justify the exception (critical hire for infra roadmap).

Marked the comp plan and justification in the attached calc.
